title: Using Workspace (SAO inside IST)
body: Workspace embeds GNU Health SAO inside the IST shell (header + sidebar) at /workspace. Use it for Tryton wizards and deep screens not yet mirrored in React (CoA, fiscal years, lab create-test, invoice post/pay, module upgrade apply). Open from Favorites → Workspace, or any “Open in Workspace” button (Setup Hub, Financial, Companies, Model browser). Same-origin only: SAO loads from /sao/ on this host — do not use external SAO URLs in the iframe. Optional: “Open SAO in new tab” if you need a full browser tab. Sign-in: use IST login first; if SAO asks for credentials again inside the frame, sign in with the same Tryton user. Theming: SAO uses IST navy/gold via custom.css on the server. See also Setup Hub order and financial checklist. Related: SAO_EMBED_AND_SCREEN_PARITY.md.
steps: Open Favorites → Workspace, or click Open in Workspace on a stub page.
Complete the SAO wizard or form inside the embedded client.
Return to React routes (Patients, Appointments, …) for daily list/create screens.
